summary: Full backend + frontend test run. All 3 backend pytest tests pass including sharing-removed assertion and import endpoint. Frontend: login, add/reveal/copy/edit/delete item, search, password generator (modal + inline), no share buttons, mobile vault view — all working correctly.

issues: Sidebar (with logout button and vault nav) is hidden on mobile — logout is accessible via bottom user-pill area. Not a bug, but logout button visibility on mobile should be verified by E1 if desired.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 21: Fernet key is regenerated on every server restart (if VAULT_KEY is not set), meaning all previously encrypted data becomes unreadable after restart. VAULT_KEY should always be set in .env.

Frontend vault-nav data-testid element is in the sidebar which is hidden on mobile — test selectors that wait for visible vault-nav will timeout on mobile (this is a test-only note, not a product bug).
